poetries: Dilo me kuchh khwahish lekar ghar se nikal gaye hum, thode door chale kuchh mod mile uspe thokar khakr gir gaye hum, hausale buland thi aur Rago me josh thi girke bhi SMBHAL gye hum, fir shaam hui thodi si aaram hui mano ki sbr gye hum, subah hui to Yaad aaya ki sapno ke liye apno se Kis kadar bichhad gye hum, maano tootaa aasman se ek tara ki dhundhne se bhi na mile is kadar bikhar gye hum

Mujhe kisi se milna aur use bhi mujhse beintehaan mohabbat hona, bas yahi mera ek khwaab tha; Tut ke kisi ko chahna, aur chah kar bhi tut jaana, mere pyaar pe bharosa na hone ka jawaab tha? Ya yun kahun ki tod kar kisi ko bas ye keh dena ki 'maine bhi toh kiye the tumhare saath saare problems ko cater, but you deserve someone better,' kya ye duniya ki haqiqat aur uska bhi swabhav tha?

Un kapdo ne apni mahak se pure badan ko mahkaya hoga, Ungli me ring aur Kano me jhumka ne bhi apni aawaj se khoob bahlayaa hoga, Meri Jaan tum to 20 ki ho gyi ab Is janmdin pe aapko dher sari badhaiyan, Aane wale dino me aapko bahut sari khushiya mile Aur Aapko mahsus na ho kathinaiyan Once more aapko janmdin ki bahut bahut badhaiyan.

Jab bhi tumhari Yaad Aati hai to chehre pe halki si hasi aati hai, Dil ke kisi kone se tumhare liye bebasi aati hai, aur pyar to tumhare najro me bs temporary hai ye soch ke mujhe tumhari soch pe jor ki hasi aati hai

Bazaar me to Hazaar milenge tumhe, aur mai nhi kahta ki mohabbat nhi hongi tumhe, Pr kabhi raato me sukoon se 2 pal khud ke sath gujarna shayad tumhe ahsas ho ki khwahiso ko pura krna to thik pr uske mohabbat me baat hi kuchh aur thi

Mohabbat nahi rulati par yadein rulati hai, din kat jata hai khamosi se par gahri ratein rulati hai, kaun kahta hai ki dil ki khwaish mukammal hone pr khush hote hain janab, hazaro ki bheed me bhi akelepan ki udasi rulati hai.

Suna hai tumhare baare mein poore sheher mein charcha hai, amiron tak to theek tha tumhare liye to faqiron ne bhi karodon kharcha hai, kisi ne tumhare liye kuchh linein likhi aur kisi ne poori kahaniyaan, anjaan hoon main ab tak ki tum kaun ho, kya tumhare paas mere liye koi parcha hai?

Kuchh raat hongi kaali ghani andheri si par ye tumhe bs Drane aayenge, Toofan bhi Pura jor lgake tumhe harane aayenge, Nirantar mehnat karna aur Yaad rakhna pita ki mehnat aur unki sakal ko, jo log aaj sakal dekh muh mod lete hain, wo kl phool ki mala pahnane aayenge.
Ab aas nhi hai mujhe ki mere life me kuchh Acha hoga, tumhe mangta tha Mai uper wale se, usne kaha ki tu bhul Jaa use fir sb Acha hoga

Haal na puchho ki kis haal me jee rha hu mai Anshu ke ghut pee kr hi to chal Rha hu mai Kambakht kitna jaalim hai ye duniya ye jante tha aur sach kahu to Manjil paana utna muskil nhi tha, par tere intazar me barso gujar diya hu mai

Tum kaho to tumhari jindagi sawar du, Tum kaho to waqt kya apni jindagi udhar du, Ye kahne aur manne ka to jamana ab rha nhi par sach kahu to dili tamanna hai ki bich chaurahe pe tumhare doglapan utar du

Waqt thoda sa hai isko thoda aur sambhal lo, ye tumhari nadani nhi jo tumhe maaf kregi, Tumhe lagta hai ki galti anjane me thi, Par Yaad rkhna Anjaan se kisi ki jaan bnke Anjaan bn jana, kabhi kabhi jaan pr bhi bn aati hai

Kitna khubsurat pal tha, jab sath me hum the; muskile bhi karib nahi aayi, jab tere paas mein hum the; Kuchh pal bite, kai din bite aur bit gaye kuchh saal, pata nahi tha is mod pe le aayegi bitate hue ye kaal, Kash hum thode aur sambhal lete, mohre ki wo chaal, jisko banaya tha tumne mere khilaf jo dhaal, Asliyat to wahi thi jo dikhne me lag gaye kuchh saal, kya mila tumhe badle me, badal ke uska haal, jaake dekho us maa ko jisne kho diya sone sa wo laal, aur haa ye waqt waqt ki baat hai, kuchh waq...

Tumhe thik se paya bhi nahi ki tumhe bhulane ke din aa gye, Mera dil tak to thik tha, meri Jaan kyu dusre ke adhin Aa gaye, Tum pass thi, tum aas thi, yahi to sabse khas thi, Baaki sab bakwas thi Tum door hui aur hamari kahani bhi badi mashhoor hui, Kahne ko to wo bas ek ahsaas tha, par sach kahu tumse door jakar mera dil bahut udaas tha, Kabhi hath bhi nahi chhodne wale ke sath chhodne ke din aa gaye, kasmein to milke khayi thi ki jiyenge sath aur marenge sath, tum to apna ghar basa li aur Haa aasan maut to hame ab bhi gawara nahi isliye jindagi se ladne tere bin aa gaye |
Bafa ka Anjaam usne apni bewafayi se diya Bharose ka parinaam usne ruswayi se diya Mai uske liye apni khuddayi tak Chhod diya Jiska Anjaam usne khudgarji se diya
Sharab to yunhi badnaam hai, asli nasha to aapko dekhne se aata hai. Yunhi dar-ba-dar bhatakte rahe galiyon mein hum, par sala dil ko sukoon to bas aapki lafzon se aata hai.

Ek Raat hui thi lambi si, ghana andhera chhaya tha US raat ko apne anshuo se hi takiye ko bhingaya tha, Kaun kahta hai ki pyaar me sukoon milta hai Yaron Jara si gahrai me gota to lagao kinare pe manjil nhi milti hai Do naav pe sawar hone wale log aksar doob jaya krte hain

Chain se jeene ke liye bechain sa rha firtaa hu Khushiya dhundh te hue pagal sa ghumta rhta hu Manjil ko pane ke liye khwawo me khoya rhta hu Spne hkikat ho aur jindagi aasan ho iske liye hosh me rha krta hu Lakh kosis kiye ki khayal naa aaye uske pr takiye ko seene se lgate hi bs uske khayalo me soya krta hu.

Log to kahte hain hum sote hain Taaki agli subah sun ske shant si awaj ki Pr mai sota hu Taaki agli subah firse uski Yaad Aa ske Ab wo Yaad uski pahli khayal ki ho, ya yaad pahli aawaj ki Hum to ashiq hain janab hme to uski chaal tk Yaad hai Chahe Yaad pahli mulakat ki ho ya fir najarandaj ki.
Jindagi bahut haseen hai isko haste haste jilo Manjil ki kathinaiyon ko amrit smjh ke pilo Hr koi tumhe apna Waqt nhi deta, jo de rhe Hain usse to ek baar mil lo.

Muskurate chehre pe teri, Noor hai bekaraar, Tumhari khubsurti mein, hai kuchh to khas baat. Chandi raat me bhi hai, tumhari khwabon ka ye asar, Nadan hai ye Dil Jo puchhta hai ki bata kab hogi hamari mulakat.
Raat me taare ginna, din me khwab sajana chahta hu Zindagi ki raho me, kisi manzil ko pana chahta hu. Sukoon ka pal, sard bhari
